# `quote`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
quote(str)
```

Returns `str` enclosed by single quotes and each instance of single quote in it is preceded by a backslash.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- quote, example 1
> SELECT quote('Don\'t');
'Don\'t'
```
